domain: normalized Boolean CNF of maximum clause width <=3

theorem.statement: Fix a constant s>=1. If a width<=3 CNF F with sigma(F)=s has no R44AT nonexpanding variable, then a polynomially computable surplus witness V with |Gamma(V)|-|V|=s has |V|<=floor(3s/2); therefore the entire witness can be exactly eliminated by a constant number of Davis-Putnam eliminations with polynomial charged work for that fixed s.
proof_core: No R44AT variable means p(v)q(v)>p(v)+q(v) for every variable, hence every variable has total degree at least 5.
For a surplus witness V, width<=3 gives sum_{v in V} d(v)<=3|Gamma(V)|=3(|V|+s).
Eliminating at most floor(3s/2) variables by exact Davis-Putnam has a polynomial bound whose exponent may depend on fixed s.

review_correction.important: The mere existence of one exact polynomial Davis-Putnam step is generic for arbitrary CNF and is NOT the theorem progress here.
review_correction.nontrivial_content: The bounded size of an entire minimum-surplus witness under the no-R44AT condition, and therefore fixed-s polynomial batch elimination of that witness.
review_correction.removed_claim: UNBOUNDED_SURPLUS_COMPRESSION_OR_DESCENT is not justified as a new frontier merely by this theorem.

complexity.bounded_witness_case: If M_{i+1}<=2M_i^2 and k=|V|<=floor(3s/2), then M_k<=2^(2^k-1)m^(2^k). For each fixed s this is polynomial in the original input size.
complexity.ceiling: The exponent depends on s; no closed polynomial trajectory or uniform unbounded-s algorithm is established.

exactness.semantics: Each Davis-Putnam elimination is exact existential projection and preserves satisfiability.
exactness.strict_batch_progress: All variables of the nonempty witness V are removed in the batch.

next_admissible_math.rule: Do not use R44BB-SURPLUS as evidence that unbounded surplus alone is the unique remaining obstruction.
